groups.note: Actual grapsas is an aorist active nominative masculine singular writing participle, rendered he-having-written in the letter-introducing continuation. Its actual participial form remains without a separately printed Greek he pronoun or finite source verb.

Actual present having/containing participle with the article/type wording noun describes the letter text, recast as after ... description around this. Printed TR has the compound containing participle periechousan; actual N1904 retains echousan plus its real typos content-pattern noun, without an invented Greek after preposition.

23:26.sourceText: Κλαύδιος Λυσίας τῷ κρατίστῳ ἡγεμόνι Φήλικι χαίρειν.
23:26.targetText: “Claudius Lysias, to the most noble governor Felix, greetings:

groups.note: Actual dative article/governor jointly owns to-the ... governor around the separate superlative honorific; no independent Greek to preposition is printed.
Actual kratisto is A-DSM-S superlative in both raw fields, rendered most-noble; the source degree and dative form remain.
Actual chairein is a present active rejoice infinitive used in the letter-greeting formula, rendered greetings. The source is not a Greek greeting noun or an imperative.

23:27.sourceText: Τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον συλλημφθέντα ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ μέλλοντα ἀναιρεῖσθαι ὑπ’ αὐτῶν ἐπιστὰς σὺν τῷ στρατεύματι ἐξειλάμην, μαθὼν ὅτι Ῥωμαῖός ἐστιν·
23:27.targetText: This man having been taken by the Jews, and being about to be killed by them—having come with the army, I rescued him, having learned that he is a Roman;

groups.note: Actual man is the same immediate seized/endangered/rescued patient, named man and resumed by English him under rescued. Exact N1904 has no second personal object pronoun after rescued, unlike printed TR; the link reuses this real participant noun rather than inventing that extra pronoun.
Actual anaireisthai has functional V-PPN/formal V-PEN present nonactive infinitive analyses, rendered to-be-killed with the actual anaireo slaying head retained.
Actual exeilamen is an aorist middle first-singular rescuing predicate, rendered I-rescued; its actual middle source form remains.
Actual Rhomaios is an A-NSM ethnic adjective substantivized as a-Roman, retaining its adjective morphology rather than a source noun tag.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with this-man is not separately expressed in English.

23:28.sourceText: βουλόμενός τε ἐπιγνῶναι τὴν αἰτίαν δι’ ἣν ἐνεκάλουν αὐτῷ, κατήγαγον εἰς τὸ συνέδριον αὐτῶν·
23:28.targetText: and intending to know the cause for which they were accusing him, I brought him down to their Sanhedrin,

groups.note: Actual boulomenos is a present nonactive masculine singular intending/wishing participle, rendered intending with its real lexical head retained.
Actual epignonai is the epiginosko aorist active knowing/ascertaining infinitive. Printed TR uses unprefixed gnonai; the actual prefixed source head remains under to-know.

Actual auto dative is the accusation target and same immediately brought-down patient, rendered him in each clause. One real participant identity supports both local roles; its actual dative remains rather than an invented second accusative pronoun.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with their-Sanhedrin is not separately expressed in English.

23:29.sourceText: ὃν εὗρον ἐγκαλούμενον περὶ ζητημάτων τοῦ νόμου αὐτῶν, μηδὲν δὲ ἄξιον θανάτου ἢ δεσμῶν ἔχοντα ἔγκλημα.
23:29.targetText: whom I found accused concerning questions of their law, and having no accusation worthy of death or bonds;

groups.note: Actual enkaloumenon has functional V-PPP-ASM/formal V-PEP-ASM present nonactive participial analyses, rendered accused rather than a retagged aorist source.
Actual genitive article/law jointly owns of ... law around the actual their possessor.
Actual death genitive is the worthiness complement, rendered of-death without an independent Greek of preposition.

23:30.sourceText: μηνυθείσης δέ μοι ἐπιβουλῆς εἰς τὸν ἄνδρα ἔσεσθαι, ἐξαυτῆς ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ, παραγγείλας καὶ τοῖς κατηγόροις λέγειν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐπὶ σοῦ.
23:30.targetText: and a plot having been intimated to me against this man—about to be of the Jews—I sent to you at once, having also given command to the accusers to say the things against him before you; be strong.”

groups.note: Actual definite article/man is rendered this-man as the identified attack target, without a separately written demonstrative this.

Actual esesthai is a future nonactive/deponent being infinitive, rendered about-to-be in the report of the impending plot. Printed TR additionally has mellein intention/about-to wording; actual N1904 retains its one future being infinitive without an invented second predicate.
Actual parangeilas is one aorist active commanding participle, expanded having ... given-command without an independent Greek give verb or command noun.
Actual dative article/accusers jointly owns to-the-accusers as the command recipients.
Actual pros with accusative him is rendered against-him in the accusation-report frame. The source remains pros, with no added substantive ta or independent Greek things noun.

unmappedTarget.reason: Printed TR explicitly adds a Jewish-source/agent phrase in the plotted-attack report, while exact N1904 has no independently written Jews noun or corresponding source preposition here.
Printed TR adds ta before the against-him phrase, represented as the-things. Exact N1904 has only say pros-him before-you without that substantive article or a things noun.
Printed TR closes with erroso farewell/strength imperative. Exact N1904 has no corresponding closing predicate here.

23:31.sourceText: Οἱ μὲν οὖν στρατιῶται κατὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον αὐτοῖς ἀναλαβόντες τὸν Παῦλον ἤγαγον διὰ νυκτὸς εἰς τὴν Ἀντιπατρίδα·
23:31.targetText: Then, indeed, the soldiers according to that directed them, having taken up Paul, brought him through the night to Antipatris,

groups.note: Actual neuter article nominalizes the directed/ordered participle, rendered that; no independent Greek relative pronoun is printed.

Actual diatetagmenon is a perfect passive accusative neuter singular ordering participle used substantivally, rendered directed in the exact installed that-directed-them wording. Its actual perfect passive form remains; no source active verb is invented to repair English.

Actual Paul is the same immediately taken-up and brought patient, rendered Paul and him under the coordinated carrying sequence. One real name identity supplies both local English objects, without an independently printed Greek him pronoun.
Actual night genitive under through is rendered the-night without a separately written source article.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual articles with Paul and Antipatris are not separately expressed in English.

23:32.sourceText: τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἐάσαντες τοὺς ἱππεῖς ἀπέρχεσθαι σὺν αὐτῷ, ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν·
23:32.targetText: and on the next day, having permitted the horsemen to go on with him, they returned to the stronghold;

groups.note: Actual dative article/next-day adverb is the temporal on-the-next-day expression, without a separate Greek on preposition or day noun.
Actual aperchesthai is a present nonactive going-away/on infinitive, rendered to-go-on with its real aperchomai compound head retained.

23:33.sourceText: οἵτινες εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὴν Καισαρίαν καὶ ἀναδόντες τὴν ἐπιστολὴν τῷ ἡγεμόνι, παρέστησαν καὶ τὸν Παῦλον αὐτῷ.
23:33.targetText: those having entered into Caesarea, and delivered the letter to the governor, also presented Paul to him.

groups.note: Actual hoitines is a nominative plural relative, recast as demonstrative those beginning the English continuation; its actual relative morphology remains.
Actual anadontes is an aorist active plural delivering/handing-over participle, rendered delivered under the shared having. No aorist finite source form is substituted.

Actual letter is delivered here and is the same immediately read object in English34. The source letter noun remains rendered here and is shared by the explicit foreign anchor for [it]34, not moved or duplicated as a new Greek word.

Actual dative article/governor jointly owns to-the-governor as the letter recipient; the same actual governor noun also supports the immediate elliptical reader subject named in English34, by explicit foreign source anchor there.

23:34.sourceText: ἀναγνοὺς δὲ καὶ ἐπερωτήσας ἐκ ποίας ἐπαρχείας ἐστὶν, καὶ πυθόμενος ὅτι ἀπὸ Κιλικίας
23:34.targetText: And the governor having read [it], and inquired of what province he is, and understood that [he is] from Cilicia;

groups.note: One actual estin present third-singular being predicate supplies English he-is in the province question and the immediate elliptical [he-is] in the Cilicia answer. Both are the same person/origin predicate, with the second English realization repeating its understood copula; no second Greek copula or pronoun is invented.

Actual pythomenos is an aorist nonactive/deponent masculine singular learning/ascertaining participle, rendered finite understood under the English coordinated report. Its actual participial form and pynthanomai head remain.

23:35.sourceText: Διακούσομαί σου, ἔφη, ὅταν καὶ οἱ κατήγοροί σου παραγένωνται· κελεύσας ἐν τῷ πραιτωρίῳ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου φυλάσσεσθαι αὐτόν.
23:35.targetText: “I will hear you,” he said, “when your accusers may also have come”; he also commanded him to be kept in the Praetorium of Herod.

groups.note: Actual diakousomai is a future nonactive/deponent first-singular hearing-out predicate, rendered I-will-hear with its actual judicial/hearing compound head retained. Primary lexical source: https://www.billmounce.com/greek-dictionary/diakouo.
Actual sou genitive is the hear-person complement, rendered direct English you; the source case remains genitive rather than an invented accusative pronoun.
Actual paragenontai is an aorist nonactive/deponent third-plural coming/arriving subjunctive, rendered may ... have-come. No Greek perfect or independent may auxiliary is printed.

Actual keleusas is an aorist active nominative masculine singular commanding participle, rendered finite he ... commanded in English. Printed TR uses a finite commanded form; the actual participial source remains, with the same speaking officer as understood actor and no new Greek he pronoun.
Actual genitive article/Herod jointly supplies of-Herod as the Praetorium qualifier, preserving the real personal name head.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with your-accusers is not separately expressed in English.

unmappedTarget.reason: Printed TR adds te with its finite commanded predicate in the closing injunction. Exact N1904 has a commanding participle without a separate additive particle here.
